CANONICAL_NAME.value: MINPACK-1 (double precision) -- More, Garbow, Hillstrom, Argonne

VERSION.value: netlib.org/minpack as served 2026-09-12 (25 routine files + 23 ex/ test files)

value.lineage: MINPACK (1980, Argonne National Laboratory): Levenberg-Marquardt least squares (LMDER/LMDIF/LMSTR) and Powell hybrid dogleg for nonlinear equations (HYBRD/HYBRJ), with CHKDER Jacobian checking; ancestor of scipy.optimize.leastsq/fsolve

HUMAN_PROBLEM.value: curve fitting and root finding for nonlinear models, robustly, in 1980 Fortran

value.built_to: find x minimising sum of squares of m nonlinear functions, or solving n nonlinear equations, from a user function with or without an analytic Jacobian
value.pressure: ill-conditioned Jacobians, expensive function evaluations, users who cannot write a correct derivative (hence CHKDER)
value.success_means: convergence to a solution within the user's tolerances with a bounded number of function evaluations; the ANL-80-74 test set

ANCESTRY.value: MINPACK (1980, Argonne National Laboratory): Levenberg-Marquardt least squares (LMDER/LMDIF/LMSTR) and Powell hybrid dogleg for nonlinear equations (HYBRD/HYBRJ), with CHKDER Jacobian checking; ancestor of scipy.optimize.leastsq/fsolve
